messages.content: Calculate the greatest common divisor between 128 and 256.

function.name: calculate_lcm
function.description: Calculate the least common multiple (lcm) between two integers.

num1.description: First number to calculate lcm for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate lcm for.

method.description: The specific method to use in the calculation. Supported values: 'standard', 'reduced'. Default 'standard'

function.name: calculate_gcd
function.description: Calculate the greatest common divisor (gcd) between two integers.

num1.description: First number to calculate gcd for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate gcd for.

algorithm.description: The specific algorithm to use in the calculation. Supported values: 'euclidean', 'binary'. Default 'euclidean'

message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to calculate the greatest common divisor (GCD) between 128 and 256. I have a function called calculate_gcd that can do this. Let me check the parameters:

- num1: First number to calculate gcd for (required) - this would be 128
- num2: Second number to calculate gcd for (required) - this would be 256
- algorithm: The specific algorithm to use (optional, default 'euclidean') - I can use the default or specify 'euclidean' or 'binary'

Since the user didn't specify which algorithm to use, I'll use the default 'euclidean' algorithm.
